result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold a new Clean Architecture solution.

USAGE:
    cleanarch new <project-name> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <project-name>    The PascalCase name for the generated solution (e.g.      
                      InventorySystem)                                          

OPTIONS:
                      DEFAULT                                                   
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -d, --database    none       Database provider to scaffold. Accepted values:
                                 none | sqlserver | postgres                    
    -o, --output                 Directory in which the solution folder will be 
                                 created. Defaults to the current working       
                                 directory                                      
        --aspire                 Include .NET Aspire (AppHost + ServiceDefaults)
                                 in the generated solution
